o1.what_would_make_it_a_10: Two or three finished press-ready WhatsApp/email variants per segment, with the WhatsApp opt-in cap and 15%-code expiry wording written out exactly as it will ship.

o2.what_would_make_it_a_10: Rework the value section to the same simple gross-profit-per-order × extra-orders × holdout logic, and drop the 2-order multiplier, so I can trust the headline figure.
